title: Angles of a Triangle
goal: Solve Angles of a Triangle: Validate positive area, map opposite sides to vertices, and derive sorted angles with the law of cosines.
strategy: Validate positive area, map opposite sides to vertices, and derive sorted angles with the law of cosines.

phasePurposes.start: Associate sorted sides a, b, c with opposite vertices A, B, C.
phasePurposes.check: Require a + b > c, not equality.
phasePurposes.angle: Compute each opposite angle in degrees.
phasePurposes.done: Return sorted angles, or an empty array for invalid geometry.

edgeCases: The two shorter sides must sum strictly above the longest; equality gives a degenerate triangle, not valid angles.
inputRules: Enter exactly three integer side lengths between 1 and 1000, for example [3,4,5].
